MALACAÑAN PALACE
BY THE PRESIDENT OF THE PHILIPPINES
[ EXECUTIVE ORDER NO. 113, August 31, 1937 ]
EXTENDING THE CEBU BURNT DISTRICT
For the purpose of widening and improving certain streets in the City of Cebu, as contemplated in the
approved development plan for this City, I, MANUEL L. QUEZON, President of the Philippines, by virtue of
the powers vested in me by law, do hereby extend the Cebu Burnt Area to include that part of the City of Cebu
bounded by Legaspi Street on the North, Martires Street on the east, Juan Luna on the south, and Sanciangco
Street on the west, and placed said area under the jurisdiction and control of the committee appointed under
Act Numbered One thousand three hundred ninety-three, entitled “An Act providing for the widening of the
streets and the adjustment of ownership of the land located within certain specified limits in the municipality
of Cebu, Province of Cebu,” as amended by Acts Numbered One thousand nine hundred ninety and Two
thousand one hundred fifty.
Done at the City of Manila, this thirty-first day of August, in the year of Our Lord, nineteen hundred and
thirty-seven, and of the Commonwealth of the Philippines, the second.
(Sgd.) MANUEL L. QUEZON
President of the Philippines
By the President:
(Sgd.) ELPIDIO QUIRINO
Secretary of the Interior
